[EN] The desert harts around here are beautiful—particularly their horns.

Unfortunately, those Tenebrara's evil tricks seem to have spread to those handsome creatures as well.

I can't get rid of them because Felion might find me if I leave my bush.

Since you're going to have to kill them anyway—you know, because they're evil—you may as well bring me their horns, too.
[ES] Los ciervos del desierto por aquí son hermosos, en particular sus cuernos.

Desafortunadamente, los malvados trucos de Tenebrara parecen haberse extendido también a esas hermosas criaturas.

No puedo deshacerme de ellos porque Felion podría encontrarme si salgo de mi arbusto.

Ya que vas a tener que matarlos de todos modos —ya sabes, porque son malvados—, bien podrías traerme sus cuernos también.

[EN] Excellent! I have been waiting years to get my hands on these horns!

Uh, I mean...tragic. Tragic that such handsome beasts had to be slain.

Here, just take your cut and get out, yeah?
[ES] ¡Excelente! ¡Llevo años esperando ponerle las manos encima a estos cuernos!

Eh, o sea... trágico. Es trágico que bestias tan hermosas hayan tenido que ser aniquiladas.

Toma, quédate con tu parte y vete, ¿sí?

[EN] Look, I know it's tragic to kill such beautiful animals, but it's really very important that I get those horns.

Because of that horrible spell. The spell has affected all the animals, you know.
[ES] Mira, sé que es trágico matar animales tan hermosos, pero es muy importante que consiga esos cuernos.

Debido a ese horrible hechizo. El hechizo ha afectado a todos los animales, ya sabes.
